description: This file implements utility functions related to user and group management, including retrieving supplementary groups, converting group names to IDs, checking group membership, and obtaining the system-wide user home directory.

methods.name: GetSuplementaryGroups
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supplementary group IDs for the current process.

methods.name: GroupIdFromName
methods.description: Converts a group name to its corresponding group ID.

methods.name: InGroup
methods.description: Checks if the current process belongs to a specified group.

methods.name: SystemWideUserHome
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the current user's home directory.
